_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: Settings whose profile was deleted can be saved as a new one. The conversation /c/{{SLUG}} uses the profile "E2E gone". Call "settings tool overrides" returns the tool_overrides of the conversation's settings as JSON. The screen is a 1280x800 desktop window. Name elements by ARIA role and accessible name, as Playwright's getByRole does; "named X" means an exact name match, "whose name contains X" a substring one. "The panel" is ".model-picker-panel". To "open the knob": click ".model-picker-inline .p-select-label"; the panel should be visible. To "edit tools": click the button whose name contains "Edit" inside the panel's data-testid "model-picker-tools"; the panel should be hidden. "The pills" are data-testid "model-picker-profiles"; "the profile X" is the radio (role "radio") named X inside them. To "edit profiles": click the button whose name contains "Edit" inside the pills. "The section" is data-testid "model-picker-auto-compaction"; "the section's X" is the radio named X inside it, and "the nudge" is its select (role "combobox"). "The dialog" is the element with role "dialog". "The X tool" is the dialog's radiogroup with aria-label X ('[role=radiogroup][aria-label="X"]'). "The auto compaction row" is the dialog's data-testid "auto-compaction". To "apply": click the dialog's button whose name contains "Apply to this conversation"; the dialog should be hidden. "The markers" are the data-testid "message-modelchange" elements. "Changed" is the panel's data-testid "model-picker-profile-changed". To "save as new" a name N: click changed's button whose name contains "Save as new…", fill changed's textbox named "New profile name" with N and press Enter in it. A "row" X is the dialog's data-testid "profile-row" containing the text X. Perform the steps in order. 1. Navigate to /c/{{SLUG}}. 2. Turning on a tool that is on anyway changes nothing: open the knob; changed should be hidden. Edit tools, click the browser tool's radio named "On", then apply. Call "settings tool overrides" until it returns {"browser":"on"}. Open the knob: changed should be hidden. 3. Delete the profile in the profiles editor, which asks first: edit profiles. Click the button named "Delete" in the row "E2E gone", then that row's button whose name contains "Delete “E2E gone”". There should be no row "E2E gone" (count 0). Click the dialog's button whose name contains "Close modal". 4. Open the knob. Changed should contain the text "“E2E gone” was deleted", and changed should hold no button whose name contains "Revert" (count 0). 5. Save as new "E2E gone kept". The last marker should have the attribute aria-label exactly "Profile changed to E2E gone kept.", and changed should be hidden.

steps.value: Profile changed to E2E gone kept.
